Sparse Attention for Long Documents

Mei Lin
University of Tokyo
Abstract

Transformers scale quadratically with document length. We introduce a sparse attention pattern that keeps accuracy on long-document benchmarks while using linear memory, enabling inputs of 100,000 tokens on a single GPU.

1 Introduction

Long documents are common.

6 Conclusion and Future Work

Sparse attention matches dense attention on long documents at a fraction of the memory.

We plan to extend the method to multimodal inputs.
